function.name: check_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieves the live exchange rate between two currencies using the Frankfurter public API. Supports major fiat currencies like USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, etc.

base_currency.description: The source currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

target_currency.description: The destination currency code (e.g., JPY, CAD, AUD)
